== Notes ==
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Famine]].
* Famine coupled with [[Sympathetic Visage]] and/or [[Ancestor's Visage]] is extremely powerful when used on a single tank who is absorbing damage. It is one of the combinations that becomes more and more powerful as the number of enemies (particularly melee enemies) increases.
* Energy must be at least 1 before dropping to 0 in order for Famine to deal damage (losing fractional energy gained by energy regeneration does not count).
